name: Altın Armut
scene: A golden pear with a green leaf stands within an oval panel of flowing blue and green garden bands.
notes: Target 32–42 panes. Pear and stem use the gold/amber subject pair; the green leaf is treated as botanical background foliage with the blue/green pair. Visually checked after one regeneration: fruit now uses broad alternating outline-to-outline curved bands, closed seams and an opaque white exterior. Remaining doubts: subtle generated fill shading persists; a few neighbouring background panes share a colour and may merge during tracing; close junctions at the leaf/stem attachment and right pear shoulder require geometry-stage validation. No subject mask supplied. Design sheet only; not traced or published.
